# Greater Good Science Center

> > UC Berkeley's Greater Good Science Center translates rigorous psychological research into actionable science-based practices for building a meaningful, connected, and happy life.

The Greater Good Science Center at UC Berkeley conducts research on the roots of happiness, meaning, and social connection, then shares evidence-based practices through articles, videos, quizzes, and educational resources. The site covers wellbeing across multiple life domains including mind-body health, relationships, workplace culture, parenting, and education.

## Main Hub & Navigation

- [Greater Good: The Science of a Meaningful Life](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu): Homepage for UC Berkeley's Greater Good Science Center research hub
- [Topics](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/topic): Topic directory and article index for science-based wellbeing content

## Research & Content by Life Domain

- [Mind & Body](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/mind_body): Mind and body research section covering neuroscience and mental health
- [Relationships](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/relationships): Relationships and social connection content hub with research articles
- [Parenting & Family](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/parenting_family): Parenting and family relationships content with child development research
- [Workplace](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/workplace): Workplace wellbeing and organizational culture research section
- [Education](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/education): Education resources for social-emotional learning and student support

## Interactive Quizzes & Self-Assessment Tools

- [Quizzes](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/quizzes): Collection of interactive self-assessment quizzes for wellbeing topics
- [Purpose in Life Quiz](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/quizzes/take_quiz/purpose_in_life): Interactive purpose in life assessment using Claremont Purpose Scale
- [Gratitude Quiz](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/quizzes/take_quiz/gratitude): Gratitude assessment tool based on psychological research scales
- [Altruism Quiz](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/quizzes/take_quiz/altruism): Altruism and generosity self-assessment interactive personality quiz
- [Connection to Humanity Quiz](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/quizzes/take_quiz/connection_to_humanity): Empathy and global identification assessment tool for wellbeing
- [Social Capital Quiz](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/quizzes/take_quiz/social_capital): Social capital assessment measuring online and offline connections
- [Happiness at Work Quiz](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/quizzes/take_quiz/happiness_at_work): Workplace happiness self-assessment tool for employee engagement

## Video Resources

- [Videos](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/video): Video library featuring parenting guidance and wellbeing content
- [Bridging Differences for Teens and Parents](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/video/series/bridging_differences_for_teens_and_parents): Video series on teen-parent communication and emotional intelligence

## Support & Engagement

- [Donate](https://greatergood.berkeley.edu/donate): Donation and membership support page for Greater Good Science Center
